class.name: HTMLInputFile
class.brief_description: A read-only handle to a file selected through an HTML input.
class.description: Returned by [method HTMLInputElement.get_files] and as the value of a file entry in [method HTMLFormElement.get_form_data]. The handle retains access to the selected file while referenced and exposes its base name.

method.name: read_bytes
method.description: Reads up to [param count] bytes at the zero-based [param offset]. Returns an empty array when the range is empty, invalid, or outside the file.

members.member: The selected file's size in bytes at selection time.
